final_message:
Milk that runs out today now shows up in the expiring list. The full suite passes (12 tests), but I didn't replay the recording itself against the API.

The bug was in `Store.expiring` in `pantry/store.py`. The filter used `today < i.expires_on`, which dropped anything expiring on `today`. I changed it to `today <= i.expires_on`.

I also added a regression test in `tests/test_store.py`. It adds milk (2026-10-21) and yogurt (2026-10-23), asks for the next three days on 2026-10-21, and expects both.

I haven't committed anything.
